arguments.title: test: validate frontend parity deadlines and member reveal
arguments.body:
## Purpose

The published deadline fix, three catalog regressions and member reveal step need complete execution on source 9d79abcf1f5c498687c2e5c443e3edf220070aa6. This Draft PR validates that fixed source against its unchanged ancestor 77993819c233737f1e2b4c11c8ca1a5d360bcbe3.

## Changes and coverage

The snapshot contains the accepted frontend parity fixes, all 139 original Node cases plus ten deadline cases, the full 43-case model catalog file, the unchanged 85-case provider-management file, and one bounded scroll to Alice before the original guarded member click. The driver has 798 lines under the unchanged 800-line limit.

Existing workflows select all 18 Host UI jobs, four frontend shards and their aggregate; the five packaged platform tuples; Stage 1 OpenCode checks; announcements; and CI fast feedback. Claude and Codex use the existing finite TEST peers. Actual OpenCode execution stays within the existing pinned localhost-model paths.

Workflow bytes, dependencies, filters, original deadlines and strict native assertions are preserved. Full qualification is expected to fail the existing Draft policy. CodeQL and OpenCode diagnostics retain their explicit Draft skips. Every other failure, skipped or unreached step and unavailable artifact remains visible.

CI's ten imported deadline cases run within the whole 149-case module under its existing Node selection. The separately pinned local Node 24.22.1 RED/GREEN attempt remains unexecuted while its environment is unavailable.

Both snapshot refs and this PR's metadata stay fixed while selected runs are active. The original PR #1218 remains terminal. This evidence scope does not include Ready conversion, merge, release, Stage 2, or a native-custody waiver.

Resolve uncertainty only by exact-new-ref/PR readback; do not blindly repeat, overwrite an unexpected ref, create a duplicate PR, switch names or fall back to dispatch/rerun. Partial creation remains explicit for root's existing process.

Required documentation pushes may continue only on the separate working evidence branch.

If the inherited filtered-search cap is reached, subdivide only the same new-action time window. A first-page or latest-attempt wrapper is not a completeness proof.

Index metadata or an unextracted ZIP is not a receipt/screenshot review. Do not assume a currently available binary decoder or executor.

For all four frontend shards retain full JSON/logs, target43 and85 identities/results, all other pass/fail/pending counts and exclusions. Do not assume the old85 file stays on shard2.
